907 Penal Code, 1860 - s.302 - Murder - Incident occurred A B on a ship while it was on the high seas - Allegation that appellant-helmsman killed another helmsman with a knife - C Conviction of appellant based on circumstantial evidence - Justification - Held: On facts, not justified - There were in the prosecution version - The very fact that two blood-stained .knives were found by the prosecution proves that the prosecution failed to give sufficient D explanation as to who had assaulted the deceased by using another knife - Two other helmsmen present when appellant allegedly
